content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers

For digital creators in Ethiopia, the options for payment solutions are limited. While traditional payment processors like PayPal and Stripe are restricted, alternative solutions like NOWPayments and Binance P2P offer a way to collect payment from international buyers. NOWPayments, for instance, supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including USDT on Tron, which settles in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10. This makes it an attractive option for digital creators who want to minimize transaction fees and maximize payment speed. Binance P2P, on the other hand, supports local currencies like the naira, cedis, and Kenyan shillings, making it a viable option for creators who want to cater to local buyers.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

When it comes to handling restricted countries, both NOWPayments and Binance P2P offer robust solutions. NOWPayments, for example, uses a decentralized architecture that allows creators to collect payment from anywhere in the world, without relying on a single payment processor. This makes it an ideal option for creators who want to reach global audiences but face restrictions in certain countries. Binance P2P, on the other hand, uses a peer-to-peer model that connects buyers and sellers directly, eliminating the need for intermediaries and reducing the risk of restricted country issues.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

In terms of payment speed, fees, and real costs, both NOWPayments and Binance P2P offer competitive solutions. NOWPayments, for instance, offers lightning-fast payment processing that settles in under a minute, with fees as low as 0.5%. Binance P2P, on the other hand, charges a flat fee of 0.1% for transactions, making it an attractive option for creators who want to minimize transaction fees. However, it's essential to note that both solutions come with their own set of costs, including gas fees for NOWPayments and network fees for Binance P2P.
Using a decentralized payment solution like NOWPayments can help you minimize transaction fees and maximize payment speed.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

When it comes to ownership, automation, and delivery, both NOWPayments and Binance P2P offer robust solutions. NOWPayments, for instance, allows creators to own their payment data and automate their payment processing using its APIs. Binance P2P, on the other hand, offers a range of automation features, including automatic payment processing and delivery. This makes it an ideal option for creators who want to streamline their payment processing and focus on growing their business.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Ultimately, the choice between NOWPayments and Binance P2P depends on your specific situation. If you're a digital creator in Ethiopia who wants to collect payment from international buyers, NOWPayments may be the better option due to its decentralized architecture and competitive fees. However, if you're a creator who wants to cater to local buyers and minimize transaction fees, Binance P2P may be the way to go. Regardless of which solution you choose, it's essential to consider your payment requirements and choose the solution that best meets your needs.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

The most important question for digital creators in Ethiopia is: how can I collect payment from international buyers without relying on a restricted payment gateway? The answer is to use a payment solution like NOWPayments or Binance P2P, which offers a decentralized architecture and competitive fees. By choosing the right payment solution, you can minimize transaction fees, maximize payment speed, and focus on growing your business.
Choosing the right payment solution for your digital products is crucial to success in the Ethiopian market.
